instruction: In xarray/backends/common.py, add a fourth parameter to _open_remote_file: its signature becomes "def _open_remote_file(file, mode, storage_options=None, open_kwargs=None):". Then pass it on: in place of the line "return fs.open(paths[0], mode=mode)" write an empty line, then "open_kwargs = open_kwargs or {}", an empty line, and "return fs.open(paths[0], mode=mode, **open_kwargs)".
